ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Somali Community
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota's Somali community and follow the money to determine the extent of the issue.
questions: What is the extent of the alleged fraud in Minnesota's Somali community?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and corruption in Minnesota's Somali community. By following the money, we can determine the extent of the issue and identify any potential connections to other cases.
